description.narrative: Improving Peru's Institutional Capacity and Building a National Results Based Monitoringcomma Evaluation and Information System for Social Programs. The IDF grant will help the Government design and launch an integrated M&E and Information system. 1. Strengthen the evaluation process in key Institutions. The goal is to strengthen the institutional capacity of the institutions currently carrying out some level of nation-wide monitoring to conduct improved evaluation processcomma including government-civil society interactions and the contracting of independent technical evaluation institutions. 2. Focus on program themes and outcomes instead of specific program characteristics. Due to the scopecomma size and focus of the existing programscomma a small subset of programs with similar aims will be chosen as the object of a pilot evaluation. 3. Create an integrated multi-year framework for evaluation. By establishing multi-year evaluation contracts with independent agenciescomma incentives will be provided to the best academic and research institutions to participate in the evaluation process. 4. Make the system transparent and accessible. The integrated M&E and Information system aims at improving efficiency and transparency in the use of public social funds. To enhance transparencycomma information from the evaluations will be publicly disseminatedcomma thereby not only fostering transparency but also enhancing governmental accountability. Provide support to develop processes and mechanisms for continuous and systematic evaluation and improvement of antipoverty interventions by: (i) strengthening the existing institutional framework to facilitate the systematic use of existing information systems and analyses of the effectiveness of antipoverty interventions in Peru; (ii) providing technical assistance and enhancing local capacity for the design and evaluation of specific programs; and (iii) supporting initial pilots in selected regions and programs to validate the use of the mechanism for systemic evaluation which will later be extended nation-wide to all social programs in all regions.
